    f[0] = 1 % M;
    
    // Precompute binomial coefficients modulo M
    for (i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        C[i][0] = C[i][i] = 1;
        for (j = 1; j < i; ++j)
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j] + C[i-1][j-1]) % M;
    }
    
    // Compute f[i] and dp[i]

            term = term * (i + 1) % M;
            f[i] = (f[i] + term) % M;

            // Update dp[i]

            ll part2 = f[j-1] * dp[i-j] % M * C[i-1][j-1] % M * (i + 1) % M;
            ll part3 = (ll)s * f[j-1] % M * f[i-j] % M * C[i-1][j-1] % M;

        }
    }
